sections_present: metabolomics (fibroblasts, ipsc, d14 mn, d35 mn, mouse muscle, and mouse serum)
phenotype of the individual carrying a biallelic chchd10 p.g66v variant
p.g66v variant causes a dose-dependent reduction in chchd10 amount and leads to mtisr marker induction in homozygous patient fibroblasts
mtisr marker induction is diminished upon differentiation of patient ipsc into spinal motor neurons
upregulated creatine metabolism in patient-derived motor neurons
murine model of smaj tolerates the glycine to valine substitution well
